text: {"type_map":{},"constraints":[{"id":"R1","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 6) | ((df['TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_IN'] == 0) & (df['TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES'] == 0) & (df['RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS'] == 0))"],"features":["PROTOCOL","TCP_FLAGS","CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS","SERVER_TCP_FLAGS","TCP_WIN_MAX_IN","TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT","RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES","RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS"],"rationale":"TCP flags, TCP windows, and TCP retransmission features are inapplicable and therefore zero for non-TCP flows."},{"id":"R2","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] == 1) | (df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'] == 0)"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"The IPv4 ICMP type feature is inapplicable for protocols other than ICMPv4."},{"id":"R3","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'].isin([1, 58])) | (df['ICMP_TYPE'] == 0)"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_TYPE"],"rationale":"The encoded ICMP type and code feature is inapplicable to protocols other than ICMP and ICMPv6."},{"id":"R4","category":"protocol","alternatives":["(df['PROTOCOL'] != 1) | ((df['ICMP_TYPE'] // 256) == df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE'])"],"features":["PROTOCOL","ICMP_TYPE","ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],"rationale":"For ICMPv4, the high byte of the encoded type-and-code value is the IPv4 ICMP type."}]}
